acceptance_defined: 2026-11-06 before candidate creation, execution or numerical commercial comparison; based on original complete network and independent physical/TR+interpolation analysis
reference_platform: MATLAB R2025a Update 1 / Simulink / Simscape Electrical Specialized Power Systems; saved model metadata R2025a Prerelease Update 2
known_difference: Same complete single-phase source-line-transformer-fixed-impedance-load network, same nonzero sinusoidal steady-state initialization and all compensation/equivalent branches. Two finite pi sections retain native 60Hz hyperbolic R/L/C/G correction. Exact R2+Rz1 series folding only. Existing zero-volt source represents original ideal load CurrentMeasurement. Reference signals are original commercial native states plus native-grid Cx+Du measurement projection, not direct Scope logs; no Python ODE substituted for native simulation. Normalized sending compensation and Zs currents are bus-to-ground, opposite native signs. Physical steady state from t0; first window checks numerical initialization, not a cold-start transient or broadband distributed-line propagation. No fitted shift, phase, amplitude, initial state or parameter.

internal_acceptance.independent_solution: Physical complex nodal/impedance equations with original source phase, independent of candidate initialization recursion and runtime MNA; exact sinusoidal whole-window solution for all 12 states and two port currents.
internal_acceptance.reference_self_refinement: Both complete windows, every signal <=0.1 of BOTH formal max-abs and NRMSE limits; also compare native samples and their PWL curves against independent exact physical phasors to the same reference budgets.
required_checks: all actual R/L/C/G and fixed impedance conversions including every small shunt and Rm
all 12 nonzero initial states and original source phase from independent physical equations
all state and port current PWL curves over complete windows; no discarded first interval
all relevant KCL and transformer ratio/current including magnetizing/core-loss input total
all positive winding, line, shunt, compensation, equivalent and load losses; zero ideal-T/meter power
source work = all resistor losses + 12-state stored-energy change, continuous and TR-average discrete identities separately
source/load RMS, phase and P/Q derived from independent single-phase phasors; nominal power fields are impedance ratings
TR second-order refinement against independent exact solution; do not use commercial data to tune h
internal_acceptance.energy_normalization: max(initial stored energy, integral(abs(source_power)), integral(all resistor losses), 1 joule); never nearly-zero net energy change
